courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的鐵道與交通設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring railway and transport systems through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 跨座式單軌導梁
related.transfer: 可遷移「可動構件力行程帳」與「動作回授的事件次序」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；跨座式單軌導梁的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Force-travel work of moving members" and "Event ordering in actuator feedback" transfer, while operating boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Straddle-monorail guideway beams must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦懸掛轉轍的承載路徑機構定位與鎖定證據；跨座式單軌導梁則以跨座導梁的彎扭變形幾何與車輛動態介面為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on load paths, positioning and locking evidence in suspended-monorail switches; Straddle-monorail guideway beams centres on bending, torsion, geometry and vehicle dynamics of straddle-monorail beams, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「可動構件力行程帳」與「導梁彎曲的量級檢查」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到跨座式單軌導梁，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「導梁波長與行車激振」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Force-travel work of moving members” and “Scale check of guideway bending”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Straddle-monorail guideway beams, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Guideway wavelength and running excitation", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 磁浮列車軌道梁精度控制
related.transfer: 可遷移「可動構件力行程帳」與「動作回授的事件次序」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；磁浮列車軌道梁精度控制的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Force-travel work of moving members" and "Event ordering in actuator feedback" transfer, while operating boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Guideway precision control for maglev must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦懸掛轉轍的承載路徑機構定位與鎖定證據；磁浮列車軌道梁精度控制則以以空間頻譜與測量不確定度控制磁浮導梁精度為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on load paths, positioning and locking evidence in suspended-monorail switches; Guideway precision control for maglev centres on maglev guideway precision through spatial spectra and survey uncertainty, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「可動構件力行程帳」與「導向道測量角度誤差」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到磁浮列車軌道梁精度控制，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「理想吸力模型的適用邊界」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Force-travel work of moving members” and “Angular error in guideway surveying”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Guideway precision control for maglev, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Limits of an ideal magnetic-attraction model", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 懸掛式單軌轉轍系統
history.text: 本課以可查核的工程與方法出版歷程建立背景：1901 年烏帕塔爾懸掛式鐵路開始服務旅客。；2010 年機械風險評估方法的該版標準發布。；2023 年機械安全控制設計方法更新版發布。這些日期分別是工程事件、指南重印或標準研究出版，並非宣稱本課系統在該年問世。對懸掛轉轍的承載路徑機構定位與鎖定證據而言，歷史脈絡的價值是理解需求如何從單一設備擴展到跨介面證據。本課再用轉轍連桿力臂與轉矩及中止偏斜與失訊案例連結這些方法；代表工程僅提供觀察方向，假想參數不冒充現場資料，歷史版規範也不自動等於當地現行要求。
history.textEn: The background uses checkable project events and methodological publication history. 1901: The Wuppertal suspension railway began carrying passengers. 2010: This edition of machinery risk-assessment guidance was published. 2023: An updated machinery safety-control design edition was published. These dates identify project events, guide reprints, or standards and research publications, rather than claiming that the lesson system first appeared then. For load paths, positioning and locking evidence in suspended-monorail switches, the useful historical perspective is the expansion from individual equipment to evidence across interfaces. The course connects that perspective through switch-linkage lever arm and torque and interrupted, skewed and missing-feedback cases. Reference projects guide observation only: hypothetical parameters are not field data, and historical editions do not automatically establish current local requirements.
